async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Navigate to the issues list page by clicking the 'Issues' link in the project navigation
    # Use the first link with name 'Issues' under 'Project navigation' to avoid ambiguity
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("complementary", name="Project navigation").get_by_role("link", name="Issues").first
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Click the 'New issue' button on the issues page
    new_issue_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="New issue", exact=True)
    await new_issue_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Fill in the issue title
    title_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title (required)", exact=True)
    await title_input.fill("Integrating LLMs for better prompts")
    
    # Step 4: Assign the issue to Roshanjossey
    # Look for the assignee button; from typical GitLab, it might be a button 'assign yourself' or similar
    assignee_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="assign yourself", exact=False)

        await assignee_button.click()
        # Wait for dropdown and search for Roshanjossey
        search_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Search users", exact=False)
        if await search_input.count() > 0:
            await search_input.fill("Roshanjossey")
            await page.get_by_role("option", name="Roshanjossey", exact=True).click()
    else:
        # If button not found, try other selectors for assignee field
        assignee_input = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Assignee", exact=False)

            await assignee_input.click()
            await assignee_input.fill("Roshanjossey")
            await page.get_by_role("option", name="Roshanjossey", exact=True).click()

        if await due_date_input.count() > 0:
            await due_date_input.fill("2033-04-01")
        else:

    if await submit_button.count() == 0:
        submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Create issue", exact=False)
